description:
Unit: U3
Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-04-1314-refactor-jido-test-tree-plan.md#u3-flatten-the-default-jido-test-tree

Outcome
Normal and Covenant-tagged executable tests live under their owning Jido.* namespace paths.

Requirements and decisions
R2, R4-R6, R8, R10, R12, R13; KTD3, KTD4, KTD6, KTD8.

Affected surfaces
test/jido/core_contract/**; test/jido/ai/contract/**; test/jido/**; Covenant-tagged tests; test/contracts/coverage.json; and active consumers for the default lane.

Implementation direction
Move each core_contract subtree to its component namespace and move AI contract families below specific AI owners. Rename executable modules to production Jido.* and local fixtures to Jido.Test.*. Resolve both Agent authoring_contract_test.exs destination names by their specific behavior and keep both suites. Preserve Covenant component IDs, obligation tags, active counts, and mutation ownership. Delete an overlapping test only with the KTD6 proof ledger.

Acceptance
Default tests find all moved files and do not load support as tests. Covenant discovers every prior active obligation with 100 percent coverage. Active IDs and obligation counts match the U1 baseline. Both renamed Agent authoring suites execute. No core_contract or broad AI contract path remains active.

Verification
mix test --seed 0 --warnings-as-errors
mix test.contracts
mix quality.contract
mix format --check-formatted

Completion signal
Default and Covenant proof pass from namespace-owned paths with unchanged active IDs and counts, and U4 can start.
title: U3 Flatten the default Jido test tree
